scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others --names "Dev Client","Dev Server" --prefix-colors blue,yellow "pnpm run client:dev" "pnpm run server:dev"
scripts.release: concurrently --kill-others --names "Release Client","Release Server" --prefix-colors blue,yellow "pnpm run client:release" "pnpm run server:release"
scripts.client:release: cd client && pnpm run build && cd .. && node bin/run-caddy.mjs
scripts.release:http: concurrently --kill-others --names "HTTP Client","Release Server" --prefix-colors blue,yellow "pnpm run client:release:http" "pnpm run server:release"
scripts.client:release:http: cd client && pnpm run build --mode http && pnpm exec vite preview --mode http --host --port 8090 --strictPort
